name: Boldfit Heavy Resistance Band Set for Exercise & Pull-Up Stretching

specs.Resistance Levels: 5 Strength Levels (X-Light, Light, Medium, Heavy, X-Heavy / 3-30 kg)
specs.Key Features: Sweat-resistant, non-slip elasticity, Suitable for pull-ups, squats, physical therapy, full body workout

subaspects: width size consistency vs displayed pictures
Resistant to snapping under high load

5_star.author: Arihant.Sasank
5_star.title: Good useful
5_star.body: Very good product. Helps muscles keep tense during workout intervals.

4_star.author: Lizard
4_star.title: Nearly a Year In and Still Going Strong
4_star.body: Been using for almost a year, zero signs of wear, no snapping. Variable resistance takes getting used to for pullups but amazing for pushups and arms.

3_star.author: Kunal
3_star.title: Band resize
3_star.body: Band width size is slightly thinner than displayed images, but quality is ok.

2_star.author: Abhishek
2_star.title: Slightly disappointed
2_star.body: Too thin compared to displayed picture, only 1/2 cm width.

1_star.author: Amar yadav
1_star.title: Bad Quality
1_star.body: Snaps easily under heavy tension, waste of money.
